claim_boundary: Development split only. These five tasks were already attempted under the broken 0.5B harness. A pass is feasibility of this harness and model on that consumed split, not held-out generalization. Temperature 0 and top_k 1 make another seed the same trajectory, so this protocol does not repeat seeds. A 30-task cohort, a 4B comparison, MLX weights, and extra fault injections are not part of this protocol.

model.selection_rule: Use this 14B Q4_K_M snapshot. A 32B Q4_K_M file is 19851335872 bytes. On this host a 12 GiB resident allocation fit and a 14 GiB allocation spilled about 2 GiB into the 24 GiB swap file, so 32B weights would be re-read from disk on each token. 14B Q4_K_M is the largest Apache-2.0 coder GGUF whose weights fit in that resident set. Do not switch models after a development task has been generated.

budgets.wall_seconds_reason: A non-pack probe on this host produced 35 tokens in 15.7 seconds after the model was resident, about 2.2 tokens/s. Twelve turns at the 256-token cap can exceed 1200 seconds.

success: reward.decide success is true, the diff is non-empty, and the transcript contains an applied replace_text, write_file, or apply_patch.
